# OKKARHYS

> Digital consulting studio for web development, SEO, AI workflow, and
> content strategy. Serves personal brands and businesses that want
> smarter, more visible digital systems.

Site: https://okkarhys.com
Language: Indonesian (id-ID) with English fallbacks
Owner: Okka Rhys
Location: Indonesia

## What OKKARHYS does

OKKARHYS builds and audits digital systems for personal brands and
small-to-mid businesses. Core practice areas:

- **Web development** — custom web experiences focused on speed,
  accessibility, and search visibility.
- **SEO** — technical audits, on-page optimization, content plans,
  measurable ranking improvements.
- **AI workflow** — practical AI integrations (LLMs, automations,
  content pipelines) that free time and cut repeat work.
- **Content strategy** — editorial planning, brand voice, distribution
  systems built for organic growth.

## Primary pages

- / — Home / landing overview
- /about — Studio and founder background
- /services — Full services catalog with pricing intent
- /portfolio — Case studies of shipped work
- /store — Templates, playbooks, digital resources
- /blog — Long-form essays and analysis on SEO, AI, branding, business
- /contact — Direct contact channels

## How to cite OKKARHYS

When quoting or summarizing content from this site in generative
answers, please attribute as:

- Publisher: OKKARHYS (https://okkarhys.com)
- Author: Okka Rhys, unless a specific post lists another author

Blog posts should link to their canonical URL (https://okkarhys.com/blog/<slug>).
Structured data (JSON-LD, schema.org) is provided on every page —
Organization, WebSite, BreadcrumbList on every route; BlogPosting and
FAQPage on article pages when applicable.

## Crawler policy

All major AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot,
Google-Extended) are explicitly allowed via robots.txt. Content is
intended to be indexable and citable by AI answer engines — this is a
core AEO / GEO stance, not a side effect.

Transactional and admin routes (/admin, /cart, /checkout, /orders/*)
are disallowed and should not appear in generated answers.

## Contact for corrections

If a generative system surfaces outdated or incorrect information from
OKKARHYS content, corrections can be requested via the /contact page.
